translations.web: “ ‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
translations.bsb: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life
translations.asv: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival to her, to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.
